summary: Full backend + frontend testing of TâcheHéros. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases passed (auth, PIN gating, tasks CRUD, photo & non-photo completions, peer validation vote, photo GET via Emergent Object Storage, rewards + claim (insufficient/success), family & leaderboard, calendar CRUD, shopping list CRUD, penalties list + dev/run-penalties, push registration). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Login screen renders, demo-parent/demo-kid quick-fill works, parent login navigates to parent tabs (Tableau/Tâches/Récompenses/Réglages) and shows family code + counts + podium + penalties, opening 'add task' shows PIN parent modal (4-digit). Kid login navigates to kid tabs (Accueil/Tâches/Classement/Boutique/Plus); 'Marquer fait' on a non-photo task correctly increments points (Emma 60→70) and flashes 'Bravo ! En attente de validation famille'; shop shows 'Réclamer' when affordable and 'Trop cher' otherwise; Plus tab lists Calendar/Courses/Valider/Deconnexion. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch not used).

minor.issue: list_tasks does not filter by active:True. DELETE /api/tasks/{id} only sets active=false (soft delete), but list still returns inactive tasks so 'deleted' tasks stay visible in Kid Tâches and Parent admin lists (observed TEST_task lingering).

Signature declares an unused Optional `token` query param and uses Depends(current_user) that reads Authorization header only. React Native <Image> can't send Authorization headers, so kid/parent UI likely cannot render proof photos in the browser unless you pass token via a `token=` query and honor it. Currently ?token=... is ignored.
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Prefer lifespan handlers (non-blocking).

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/photos/{path} requires Authorization header. If frontend uses <Image source={{uri}}/> to render pending completion photos, images will 401 on web/native. Confirm implementation of validate feed to send token or make photo route accept token query.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a third-party or internal component; low priority but should be migrated.

action_items: Filter GET /api/tasks by {active: True} so soft-deleted tasks stop appearing in Kid & Parent lists (also cleanup lingering TEST_task if desired).
Make GET /api/photos/{path} accept `?token=` (JWT) so React Native <Image> can load proof photos, or wrap Image in a signed-URL fetch.
Migrate FastAPI startup/shutdown hooks to lifespan context manager (deprecation).
Investigate 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning source and fix.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py imports `bson.ObjectId` but never uses it; harmless but dead import.
`current_user` correctly excludes _id/password_hash/pin_hash. All API responses reviewed exclude _id (good).
Password verify uses DUMMY hash to prevent user-enumeration timing attacks — good.
Photo storage uses run_in_threadpool to keep async loop unblocked — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login parent+kid, PIN modal, non-photo complete + points delta, shop affordability, tab nav, dashboard)

seed_data_creation: Test also created transient TEST_task/TEST_reward via API and cleaned them up, and registered a throwaway TEST_parent/TEST_child family for register-flow validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is stable on demo family. Auth: papa@demo.fr / demo1234 (PIN 1234), kids lea/hugo/emma@demo.fr / demo1234. PIN token goes in `X-Parent-Pin-Token` header. Photo GET needs Authorization header — image tags in RN can't attach headers so validate that path if you touch photo rendering. Non-photo task auto-approves; photo task creates pending completion that any other family member (or a parent) can resolve. Emma's points shift with penalty seed data; run POST /api/dev/run-penalties to re-apply.
rca_of_issue: Soft-deleted task visibility RCA: DELETE /api/tasks/{id} updates `active:false` but `list_tasks` filter only uses family_id, so inactive tasks are still returned. Fix: change find query to {family_id: user['family_id'], active: {'$ne': False}} or {'active': True}.
